run_test_case: run a test case against vLLM with a query and test name to exercise streaming tool calls
process_stream: process a streaming OpenAI chat completion response and execute tool calls with function results
run_main: run the main entry point to initialize the OpenAI client and execute all streaming tool call test cases
define_tools: define function tools with parameters and descriptions for use with vLLM OpenAI-compatible streaming chat completions
execute_tool_functions: execute tool functions mapped by name with parsed JSON arguments from streaming model responses
